method: Node integration tests using real Three.js geometry, materials, CPU raycasts, scene graph and engine model methods; constructor replaced by explicit renderer/DOM infrastructure fixture.
limitations: No WebGL context exists in the browser environment.
No shader compile, pixel rendering, frame rate, GPU memory, or mobile browser gesture claims are made.
Canvas draw and image decoding are infrastructure adapters; texture files were separately validated.

results.name: Actual asset geometry: 12 rising stair treads, open houses, roof tags
Placement transforms, enterable spawn, roof toggle and exit restoration
Sculpt modifies actual terrain and undo/redo restores heights
Terrain PBR layer painting survives save/load with normalized weights
Object surface painting and transform persist exactly through reload
Delete, undo and redo restore complete object records
Malformed imports are rejected before clearing the current world
Drawn walls and floors contain real subdivided relief geometry
Road winding faces up; traffic follows real transformed roads; empty worlds have no actors
Road surface paint survives terrain resettling and serialization
Walk mode actually ascends furnished-house stairs to the next floor
Apartment navigation crosses landings, climbs both flights and descends
Starter-world geometry inventory (not a measured GPU frame rate)
